metadata.question: Does the land surface temperature in Afghanistan increase in February 2018 compared to February 2017?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location). - Dataset: MODIS Terra LST 8-day (MODIS/061/MOD11A2), fallback to Aqua (MODIS/061/MYD11A2). - Date windows: 2017-02-01 to 2017-03-01 and 2018-02-01 to 2018-03-01. - Location: Afghanistan from USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017. 2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?). - Use QC_Day bits 0–1 == 00 (good LST) to mask. - Convert LST_Day_1km to Celsius (scale 0.02 K and subtract 273.15). - Compute valid pixel counts and total pixels to estimate valid coverage. 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3). - If collections empty after fallback: C1. - If valid pixel count == 0 for either year: C2. - If mean is null/NaN or outside plausible [-80, 70]°C: C3. - Otherwise compare 2018 mean > 2017 mean: A else B. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { try { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const afg = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Afghanistan')) .geometry(); const periods = [ { label: '2017-02', start: '2017-02-01', end: '2017-03-01' }, { label: '2018-02', start: '2018-02-01', end: '2018-03-01' } ]; const primaryId = 'MODIS/061/MOD11A2'; // Terra const fallbackId = 'MODIS/061/MYD11A2'; // Aqua // Helpers const getInfoAsync = (obj) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => obj.getInfo(resolve, reject)); function maskAndScale(img) { const qc = img.select('QC_Day'); const good = qc.bitwiseAnd(3).eq(0); // bits 0-1 == 00 => good quality const lstC = img.select('LST_Day_1km') .updateMask(good) .multiply(0.02) // scale to Kelvin .subtract(273.15) // to Celsius .rename('LSTc'); return lstC.copyProperties(img, img.propertyNames()); } async function getPeriodStats(period) { // Try primary let col = ee.ImageCollection(primaryId) .filterDate(period.start, period.end) .filterBounds(afg); let size = await getInfoAsync(col.size()); let usedId = primaryId; // Fallback if empty if (size === 0) { col = ee.ImageCollection(fallbackId) .filterDate(period.start, period.end) .filterBounds(afg); size = await getInfoAsync(col.size()); usedId = fallbackId; } if (size === 0) { return { empty: true, label: period.label, usedId: null, size: 0 }; } const colMasked = col.map(maskAndScale); const meanImg = colMasked.mean().clip(afg); // Valid pixel count after masking const validCount = await getInfoAsync( meanImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: afg, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LSTc') ); // Total possible pixels at this scale const totalCount = await getInfoAsync( ee.Image.constant(1).rename('LSTc').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: afg, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LSTc') ); // Mean temperature const meanVal = await getInfoAsync( meanImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: afg, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LSTc') ); return { empty: false, label: period.label, usedId, size, validCount: validCount || 0, totalCount: totalCount || 0, meanC: meanVal }; } const s1 = await getPeriodStats(periods[0]); const s2 = await getPeriodStats(periods[1]); // 2. Data Availability Checks if (s1.empty || s2.empty) { console.log(`${periods[0].label} Images: ${s1.size || 0} (${s1.usedId || 'None'})`); console.log(`${periods[1].label} Images: ${s2.size || 0} (${s2.usedId || 'None'})`); console.log('One or both months have no images in primary/fallback.'); console.log('C1: Empty Collection (No images found in date/location for one or both comparison points).'); return; } // 3. Processing checks: valid pixels const pct1 = s1.totalCount > 0 ? (100 * s1.validCount / s1.totalCount) : 0; const pct2 = s2.totalCount > 0 ? (100 * s2.validCount / s2.totalCount) : 0; console.log(`${s1.label} Source: ${s1.usedId.split('/').slice(-1)[0]} Images: ${s1.size}`); console.log(`${s1.label} Valid px: ${s1.validCount} / ${s1.totalCount} (${pct1.toFixed(1)}%)`); console.log(`${s1.label} Mean LST Day (°C): ${s1.meanC !== null ? s1.meanC.toFixed(2) : 'null'}`); console.log(`${s2.label} Source: ${s2.usedId.split('/').slice(-1)[0]} Images: ${s2.size}`); console.log(`${s2.label} Valid px: ${s2.validCount} / ${s2.totalCount} (${pct2.toFixed(1)}%)`); console.log(`${s2.label} Mean LST Day (°C): ${s2.meanC !== null ? s2.meanC.toFixed(2) : 'null'}`); if (s1.validCount === 0 || s2.validCount === 0) { console.log('C2: No Valid Pixels (Images exist, but after cloud masking/processing, 0 pixels remain).'); return; } // 4. Validation & Final Answer function invalid(val) { return val === null || !isFinite(val) || val < -80 || val > 70; } if (invalid(s1.meanC) || invalid(s2.meanC)) { console.log('C3: Calculation Failure (Result is None/NaN or outside plausible range).'); return; } const diff = s2.meanC - s1.meanC; console.log(`Delta (2018-02 minus 2017-02) (°C): ${diff.toFixed(2)}`); if (diff > 0) { console.log('A: Yes'); } else { console.log('B: No'); } } catch (err) { console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`); console.log('D'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
